recap:
Scott Storch sits down with Joe Rogan in JRE 2233 to discuss his incredible career as a Grammy-winning producer and the wild ride that followed. With over 50 billion streams and more than 100 million records sold worldwide, Storch is one of the most successful producers in modern music history. But this conversation goes deeper than just numbers and accolades.

Storch doesn't shy away from the harder parts of his story. He talks openly about the personal struggles and challenges that nearly derailed his career, and how he's worked to rebuild and come back stronger. The conversation touches on addiction, recovery, and what it really takes to get your life back on track in an industry that can chew people up and spit them out. It's real talk about hitting bottom and choosing to get better.

The episode digs into Storch's creative process and how he's built his legacy in music production. He discusses the craft of making beats, working with major artists, and what separates a good producer from a great one. The conversation also covers how the music industry has changed, especially when it comes to how artists and producers get compensated in the streaming era. Storch gives his perspective on what it takes to stay relevant and keep creating when the game is constantly shifting.

Storch also talks about his entrepreneurial ventures, particularly 1217 Music, and how he's focused on building something bigger than just himself. He's invested in creating opportunities for other artists and producers coming up in the industry. The discussion includes his new single 'On My Own' featuring Abbie Stair, showing that he's still actively making music and evolving as an artist.
